book_label: Example (section 4.3, population of India bar graph)
question: A bar graph shows the population of India in each decade over 50 years, in crores: 1951: 36, 1961: 44, 1971: 54, 1981: 68, 1991: 84, 2001: 102. answer: Over 50 years: 102 − 36 = 66 crores. Per decade: 8, 10, 14, 16 and 18 crores.
